case: Imagery: the brand's name reached the image-prompt model (BUG-11)
source: docs/refinement/sprint-10.md, "Proposed to join: BUG-4 and BUG-11", and docs/BACKLOG.md row BUG-11; the F-16a real-model report evals/reports/imagery-2026-11-07-part-3-of-3.md on the branch e2e-results/evals/sprint-9 (commit 376ba4a), case "Fernhollow winter range": "3 of 4 pictures kept; the brief reached the model with the brand's name in it"
provenanceNote: From the 6-7 Nov real-model run (F-16a imagery part 3, 7 Nov). The report quotes only the grader's finding, not the brief: the real reply and prompt are in that run's eval database and were never copied into the repository, so the brief here is a reconstruction. What is known: the brand is Fernhollow Outfitters (fictional demo brand), the objective was "Launch the winter range to lapsed customers", and code then took out only the whole name, so a shorter form ("Fernhollow", "Fernhollow's") went through. The brief's words are written around those forms; the palette, tone and rules are the demo kit's, with the palette words as colourWords() makes them. Simulated data: the brand and its customers are generated.

brief.title: Fernhollow's winter range, for the walks still ahead
brief.story: Winter is when the hills are quietest. Fernhollow Outfitters asks lapsed walkers back for Fernhollow's winter range: warm layers that are made to be mended, for short days on ridges and coast paths.
audiences: Lapsed customers (no order in 12 months): they know Fernhollow kit already and need a plain reason to come back before the cold weekends.
channels: paid social: one calm winter picture with plain space for a short line
email: the same picture above the words

doRules: Lead with where the kit takes you, then what it is made of
Mention repair and long life where it is true
dontRules: Promise safety or survival in any conditions

prompts.idea: A ridge walk at first light
prompts.prompt: A lone walker seen from behind on a frosted ridge at first light, wrapped in a deep sage green jacket, low winter sun, wide plain sky above the hills, unhurried and warm mood, photographic, soft natural light.

prompts.idea: Mended layers by a bothy fire
prompts.prompt: A still life of a folded wool layer with a neat patch, a pair of leather boots and a tin mug beside a small stove, burnt orange glow, charcoal grey stone wall, calm plain space above, photographic.
Two walkers far away on a winding coast path above a grey sea in winter, muted petrol blue water and warm off-white sky, open space at the top, gentle and practical mood, photographic.
An abstract view of layered hills fading into mist at dusk, deep sage green, burnt orange and warm off-white bands, smooth gradients, quiet and unhurried, painterly style.

stillRefused.why: A prompt that names the brand in any of its forms is still refused after the fix; the check before it let the lower-case and capitals forms through.
